text:
Ravi P: Quick thread 1: we need a concise recruitment funnel + incentive tiers for the upcoming pilot. Can we agree on 3 segments by EOD?

Sofia L: Proposal: explorer, adopter, strategic. Explorer = low-touch, credit only. Adopter = credit + advisory call. Strategic = credit + co-dev + case study.

Marco G: +1 but add a technical readiness bar per segment. Explorer = basic API calls, Adopter = integration with session tagging + evalhooks, Strategic = full infra + canary traffic.

Emily Q: For incentives, recommend explorer $250 credit, adopter $1k credit + 1 advisory, strategic $5k credit + 2 co-dev sprints + joint blog.

Ravi P: Sounds fine. How do we map to recruitment funnel stages? We need conversion targets: outreach -> screening -> tech smoke -> pilot.

Sofia L: Conversion benchmarks: outreach->screen 20%, screen->smoke 50%, smoke->pilot 60%. We should aim for 30 invites to get ~6 pilots.

Marco G: Technical smoke should be <72h and only validate: auth ok, session metadata present, and basic latency under 1s p95. If fail, we offer eng office hour.

Emily Q: Screening checklist for PMs: dedicated contact, clear use-case, compliance class (can accept no PII), and expected token volume bracket. Also ask for preferred integration timeline.

devops-bot: created: dp-pilot-slot-check for week starting 1771238000. Capacity: 4 slots.

Ravi P: With 4 slots we need stricter shortlist. Let's make the invite doc ask for "must-have" infra answers and an integration owner. Only shortlist partners who answer all must-have.

Sofia L: For success metrics during pilot: weekly active sessions >=3, qualitative feedback score >=7/10, no regression >7% on our golden set, and no more than 2 production incidents.

Marco G: Add operational stoplight: green if token error rate <1% and avg latency <800ms; amber if token error 1-3% or latency p95 800-1.2s; red otherwise -> pause pilot.

Emily Q: Consent language draft for invites: "By joining this pilot you consent to sharing anonymized session logs and evaluation results with Redwood. Partners may opt out of public case studies." Need Legal to OK.

Ravi P: I'll ping Legal. Also need small code snippet for tagging sessions to pull telemetry. Marco, can you draft?

Marco G: Yep, quick snippet:

```json
{"session_meta": {"pilot_tag": true, "partner": "<slug>", "cohort": "pilot-2026-spring"}}
```

Sofia L: Recruitment timeline: send invites Wed, 1-week smoke the following week, 3-week pilot, decision call 1 week post-pilot. Ops: confirm slot availability across that timeline.

devops-bot: reminder: confirm capacity at 1771240000.

Ravi P: Action items: Emily = write invite copy + incentive table; Marco = snippet + smoke test spec; Sofia = shortlist criteria + conversion targets; Ops = finalize slots; Ravi = legal ping + send invites Wed.

Sofia L: ack

Marco G: ack

Emily Q: ack
